<h2>Diagnose Trait Matrix Readiness</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Summarises coverage, transformed dynamic range, invalid values, and robust
taxon-level extremes in a community trait matrix without changing values.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>diagnose_trait_matrix_readiness(
  data_trait_table,
  vec_trait_transformations,
  taxon_column = "taxon_name",
  maximum_missing_fraction = 0.5,
  maximum_transformed_range = 4,
  outlier_fence_multiplier = 3
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_table">data_trait_table</code></td>
<td>
<p>Wide taxon-by-trait data frame.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_trait_transformations">vec_trait_transformations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Named transformation contract accepted by
[prepare_trait_matrix_for_dissimilarity()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="taxon_column">taxon_column</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar naming the taxon identifier column.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="maximum_missing_fraction">maximum_missing_fraction</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum acceptable missing fraction per
trait domain.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="maximum_transformed_range">maximum_transformed_range</code></td>
<td>
<p>Maximum acceptable transformed range.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="outlier_fence_multiplier">outlier_fence_multiplier</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-negative Tukey-fence multiplier.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing 'data_domain_summary',
'data_taxon_anomalies', and scalar 'flag_ready'.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>diagnose_trait_matrix_readiness(
  data_trait_table = tibble::tibble(
    taxon_name = c("A", "B"),
    `Plant heigh` = c(10, 100)
  ),
  vec_trait_transformations = c(`Plant heigh` = "log10")
)
</code></pre>
